news.headline:
Swiggy disclosed foreign investment at 49.76% of its paid-up equity as of July 6, 2026.

The update does not affect ownership, control, share capital, or operations of the company.

Source: BSE

CARE Ratings reaffirms PCBL Chemical's bank facilities ratings at CARE AA Negative and CARE A1.

Ratings apply to Rs. 4,665 crore facilities, reflecting stable credit with negative outlook.

Source: ScoutQuest

Morgan Stanley predicts Sensex at 1,00,000 in bull case by June 2027; base case target is 89,000.

Preferred stocks include Maruti Suzuki, ICICI Bank, Bajaj Finance, UltraTech Cement, and Adani Power.

Source: News 18

Physicswallah shares rose 2.75% to Rs 138.81 amid strong sentiment.

10.8M shares traded as investors responded to operational updates.

Source: The Economic Times Marathi

Banks are scaling back credit card rewards due to shrinking profitability, reducing points per rupee spent and tightening perks like lounge access.

Major issuers like HDFC Bank, SBI Cards, Axis Bank, and RBL have cut rewards, prioritizing sustainable profitability over aggressive customer acquisition.

Source: NDTV Profit

Redington earns Microsoft AI Frontier Distributor status, enabling large-scale cloud and AI adoption via advanced tech solutions.

Financials show Q4 FY26 revenue up 7.4% QoQ, net profit down 30.3%; strong liquidity with Rs 1,122 crore cash and low debt ratio.

Source: Trade Brains

Seshasayee Paper's board meeting on July 25, 2026, to review Q1 FY2026 financial results.

Both standalone and consolidated unaudited financials for quarter ending June 30, 2026, will be considered.

Source: BSE

Religare Enterprises Ltd received 'no objection' and 'no adverse observations' from NSE and BSE for its demerger scheme.

The scheme involves Religare Enterprises Ltd and Religare Finvest Ltd, pending regulatory, statutory, and shareholder approvals.

Source: BSE

Amicus Capital Private Equity I LLP sold 833,500 shares of Capital Small Fin Bank L at Rs 300 each.

Source: NSE Bulk Trades

Aequs Limited breaks out above resistance, consolidating near highs.

Stock shows higher highs, higher lows; resistance now acts as support.

Source: ScoutQuest

Torrent Pharma fixes July 17, 2026, as record date for JB Chemicals merger.

Shareholders to receive 51 Torrent Pharma shares for every 100 JB Chemicals shares.

Source: BSE

Maruti Suzuki receives Rs 9 crore customs notice for duty payment issues.

The firm plans to challenge the order, citing no major financial impact.

Source: News18

Titan grew revenues by 39%, while a smaller rival achieved 60% growth.

The smaller rival trades at just 9x earnings, presenting valuation disparity.

Source: Financial Express

Bayer Crop Sciences shares surged 4% post ₹2,207 crore block deal at ₹4,122/share.

11.91% equity changed hands in pre-open; stock now trades 3.3% higher at ₹4,260.

Source: CNBC TV 18

US FDA issued Form 483 with five observations for Unichem Labs' Goa facility.

Compliance gaps may delay US export approvals, posing short-term risks for Unichem Labs stock.

Source: Kotak Neo (via Company/Regulatory Filing Reference)

Unichem Labs shares rose 3.1% to 477.25, aligning with BSE Healthcare Index rally.

Investors assess US FDA inspection outcomes versus domestic and regulated market performance.

Source: The Economic Times

Titan announces Rs 15 dividend; last day to buy shares for payout.

Investors advised to act promptly to secure the dividend benefits.

Source: The Economic Times

Sar Auto surged 5% to Rs 2,988.7, hitting an all-time high.

The stock gained 12.1% in three days, outperforming a flat Sensex.

Source: Marketsmojo

Prism Johnson Ltd hits a 52-week low of Rs 114.9 on 7 Jul 2026.

The stock underperformed, dropping over 27%, while Sensex rose nearly 4% in three weeks.

Source: Marketsmojo

MOSL maintains 'Buy' on Marico, raises target price to 1,000 from 950.

The upgrade reflects sustained growth and improved profitability for Marico.

Source: ScoutQuest
